title: fastcat summary.json v1
description: Schema for the always-written summary.json aggregate summary. Self-describing dataframe and array containers use base64-encoded little-endian payloads; count columns may use adaptive unsigned integer dtypes.

schema_id.description: Identifier of the JSON Schema that defines this document.

schema_version.description: Version of the fastcat summary.json data contract.

run_summary.title: Run summary
run_summary.description: The principal human-readable overview for this output sample or barcode: accepted-read yield and count, filtering outcomes, sequencing-run metadata, and N/L read-length statistics.

sample.title: Sample metadata
sample.description: Sample and barcode identifiers for this output.

files.title: Input file summaries
files.description: Per-input-file accepted-read summaries. In a demultiplexed run, each row is scoped to the barcode represented by this summary.json file.

counts.title: Aggregate count summaries
counts.description: Machine-readable aggregate accepted-read and base totals, with frequency counters that preserve the number of reads associated with each observed run ID and basecaller model.

channels.title: Per-channel metrics
channels.description: Sparse channel-and-mux aggregates used for the channel-occupancy maps: accepted read and base totals, plus mean quality and, for aligned input, mean alignment concordance. This value is null when usable channel metadata is unavailable or when an output contains multiple flowcells.

distributions.title: Read statistic histograms
distributions.description: Histogram data for canonical reads: primary mapped and primary unmapped BAM records share the same read-length and mean-quality distributions.

time.title: Sequencing metrics over time
time.description: Chronological per-bin read and base yield, cumulative totals, and read-statistic quantiles. These values underpin the sequencing-over-time plots. This value is null when usable timing metadata is unavailable.

heatmaps.title: Quality diagnostic heatmaps
heatmaps.description: Two-dimensional count matrices relating mean read quality to read length, translocation speed, or alignment concordance. Axis metadata identifies the metric and its numeric range.

alignment.title: Alignment summary metrics
alignment.description: BAM-only record-level mapping counts, canonical-read mapping totals, per-reference flag counts, and distributions for alignment concordance, aligned query coverage, and poly-A length. This section is omitted for FASTQ summaries.

coverage.title: Reference coverage
coverage.description: Reference-depth tables for each requested global, fixed-segment, or BED target set. The summary and cumulative-distribution dataframes directly mirror fastcat's legacy coverage tables. This section is omitted unless coverage processing was requested.

kind.description: Container tag identifying this value as a numeric array.

name.description: Column name.

kind.description: Container tag identifying this value as a string array.

data.description: One string value per dataframe row.

dataframe.description: Self-describing column-oriented table. Numeric columns are base64-encoded little-endian arrays; string columns are direct JSON arrays.

kind.description: Container tag identifying this value as a dataframe.

kind.description: Container tag identifying this value as a numeric array.

dtype.description: NumPy-style little-endian numeric dtype used to decode the payload.
